usedFor: Box holds the files and Slack carries the news, so “New File” can post through “Send Message” to a channel.

bestTemplate.name: “New File” in Box, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: The team hears about a new upload in a channel without checking folders.

watchOut: A Slack channel post waits for approval today, and “New File” in Box is polling, so expect a delay.
